options.name: change_control
options.description: CloudVision Change Control to create for the deployment.

options.name: configlet_name_template
options.description: Python String Template to use for creating the configlet name for each device configuration.

options.name: configuration_dir
options.description: Path to directory containing .cfg files with EOS configurations.

options.name: cv_deploy_future
options.description: Opt-in to future `cv_deploy` behaviors which will become default behaviors in a future major version.

options.name: cv_password
options.description: Password to use if `cv_token` is missing. Not supported for CVaaS. It is strongly recommended to use Vault for this.

options.name: cv_servers
options.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses for CloudVision instance to deploy to.

options.name: cv_token
options.description: Service account token. It is strongly recommended to use Vault for this.

options.name: cv_username
options.description: Username to use if `cv_token` is missing. Not supported for CVaaS.

options.name: cv_verify_certs
options.description: Verifies CloudVison server certificates.

options.name: device_list
options.description: List of devices to deploy. The names are used to find AVD structured configuration and EOS configuration files.

options.name: preview_features
options.description:
Enable preview features of the plugin.
Preview features may change or be removed without notice.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: FQDN/IP of the HTTP CONNECT proxy server.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: Authentication password for the HTTP CONNECT proxy server. It is strongly recommended to use Vault for this.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: TCP port of the HTTP CONNECT proxy server.

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: Authentication username for the HTTP CONNECT proxy server.

options.name: return_details
options.description:
If `true` all details will be returned to Ansible and can be registered.
For large inventories this can affect performance, so it is disabled by default.

options.name: skip_missing_devices
options.description: If `true` anything that can be deployed will get deployed. Otherwise the Workspace will be abandoned on any issue.

options.name: static_config_manifest
options.description: Deploy a manifest of containers and configlets to CloudVision using the Static Configuration Studio.

options.name: strict_system_mac_address
options.description:
If `true`, raise an exception if the input data contains devices with a duplicated system_mac_address but unique serial_number values.
Otherwise, just issue a warning.

options.name: strict_tags
options.description: If `true` other tags associated with the devices will get removed. Otherwise other tags will be left as-is.

options.name: structured_config_dir
options.description:
Path to directory containing files with AVD structured configurations.
If found, the `serial_number` or `system_mac_address` will be used to identify the Device on CloudVision.
Any tags found in the structured configuration metadata will be applied to the Device and/or Interfaces.

options.name: structured_config_suffix
options.description: File suffix for AVD structured configuration files.

options.name: timeouts
options.description: Timeouts for long running operations. May need to be adjusted for large inventories.

options.name: tmp_dir
options.description:
Path to the AVD temporary directory containing validated input files.
Must be the same path as used for the `arista.avd.validate_inputs` plugin.
Required when `preview_features.read_from_validated_inputs` is `true`.

options.name: workspace
options.description: CloudVision Workspace to create or use for the deployment.
